studies.title: A Tumor suppressor complex with GAP activity for the Rag GTPases that signal amino acid sufficiency to mTORC1
studies.finding: Found the OFF switch for amino acid signaling: the GATOR1 complex is a GAP that shuts the Rag GTPases (and thus mTORC1) down when amino acids run low, while GATOR2 opposes it. GATOR1 genes are mutated in cancers, making those tumors 'blind' to starvation and hypersensitive to rapamycin.

studies.title: mTORC1 Activator SLC38A9 Is Required to Efflux Essential Amino Acids from Lysosomes and Use Protein as a Nutrient
studies.finding: SLC38A9 effluxes essential amino acids (e.g. leucine) from lysosomes to activate mTORC1.
